title: Lighting for a Coastal Boardwalk
transcript: A coastal town recently replaced part of a timber boardwalk, which gave its planners an opportunity to test new lighting. Their goal was to help people find the edge of the path without making the beach itself brighter. The first set of lights was built into the handrail and aimed downwards. During the trial, volunteers wore simple badges so an observer could distinguish them from people using the path normally. Each person walked both the new section and an older section, where lights were mounted on tall poles. Afterwards, the volunteers completed a short questionnaire. They reported that the lower lights made steps easier to see, especially when the boards were wet. Several people, however, found faces harder to recognise at a distance. The planners will repeat the test during the summer festival, because the first trial took place on quiet weekday evenings.

questions.prompt: The experimental lights were built into the ____.
questions.explanation: 第一组试验灯嵌入扶手并向下照明。

questions.prompt: Observers identified the volunteers by their ____.
questions.explanation: 志愿者佩戴徽章，以便观察者把他们和普通路人区分开。

questions.prompt: Volunteers gave feedback through a short ____.
questions.explanation: 走过两段栈道后，志愿者填写了一份简短问卷。

questions.prompt: What advantage did the volunteers report?
options: They could see faces from farther away.
Steps were easier to see on wet boards.
The lights made the whole beach brighter.
questions.answer: Steps were easier to see on wet boards.
questions.explanation: 志愿者反映低位灯使台阶更容易看清，木板潮湿时尤其明显。

questions.prompt: Why will the planners run the trial again at the festival?
options: The original trial was held when the path was quiet.
The festival will require replacement handrails.
The original trial did not use any wet boards.
questions.answer: The original trial was held when the path was quiet.
questions.explanation: 初次试验在安静的工作日傍晚进行，需要再看人多时的表现。
